activities.name: Mobility Assessment
activities.description: Perform dynamic stretches to assess range of motion in hips, shoulders and spine.

activities.name: Cardio Warm‑Up
activities.description: 10‑minute brisk walk or light stationary cycling to increase heart rate gently.

activities.name: Basic Strength Assessment
activities.description: Complete 10 bodyweight squats, 5 modified push‑ups and a 20‑second plank. Record how each exercise feels.

activities.name: Cooldown & Notes
activities.description: Stretch major muscle groups and jot down observations about mobility, strength and any discomfort.

activities.name: Flexibility & Balance
activities.description: Hold gentle yoga poses (cat‑cow, child's pose, downward dog) for 30 seconds each to evaluate flexibility.

activities.name: Low‑Impact Cardio
activities.description: 15‑minute session on an elliptical or recumbent bike at an easy pace.

activities.name: Core Activation
activities.description: Perform 3 sets of 10 bird‑dogs and 10 glute bridges to engage core and posterior chain.

activities.name: Cooldown & Notes
activities.description: Stretch lower back and legs; note any tightness or imbalances.

activities.name: Postural Assessment
activities.description: Stand against a wall to check alignment of head, shoulders and hips; practise wall angels.

activities.name: Cardio Warm‑Up
activities.description: 8‑minute light jog or fast walk.

activities.name: Bodyweight Circuit
activities.description: 2 rounds of 15 air squats, 10 lunges per leg and 15 supermans. Focus on form over speed.

activities.name: Cooldown & Notes
activities.description: Stretch quadriceps and chest; record fatigue levels.

activities.name: Balance & Stability
activities.description: Perform single‑leg stands for 30 seconds per leg; practise heel‑to‑toe walking.

activities.name: Low‑Impact Cardio
activities.description: 15‑minute swim or water aerobics if accessible; otherwise a gentle bike ride.

activities.name: Upper Body Activation
activities.description: 3 sets of 12 band pull‑aparts, 10 wall push‑ups and 15 shoulder taps.

activities.name: Cooldown & Notes
activities.description: Stretch shoulders and arms; document any weaknesses.

activities.name: Functional Movement
activities.description: Perform sit‑to‑stands from a chair 10 times and practise step‑ups on a low platform.

activities.name: Cardio Warm‑Up
activities.description: 5‑minute jump rope or march in place.

activities.name: Core & Glute Activation
activities.description: 3 sets of 12 dead bugs, 12 clamshells per side and 20‑second side planks.

activities.name: Cooldown & Notes
activities.description: Stretch hips and obliques; note progress.

activities.name: Light Circuit
activities.description: Perform a circuit of 15 bodyweight squats, 10 knee push‑ups, 15 chair dips and 20 calf raises. Rest 1 minute between exercises.

activities.name: Cardio Endurance
activities.description: 20‑minute brisk walk increasing pace halfway through.

activities.name: Flexibility
activities.description: Spend 10 minutes foam rolling or using a massage ball on tight areas.

activities.name: Cooldown & Notes
activities.description: Stretch hamstrings and triceps; reflect on any improvements in endurance.

activities.name: Active Rest
activities.description: Engage in a gentle activity such as a leisurely walk, restorative yoga session or light tai chi for 20–30 minutes.

activities.name: Weekly Reflection
activities.description: Review your notes from the week. Consider which exercises felt comfortable, which were challenging, and any areas needing attention before moving into more intensive body sculpting.
